Who it is for

Building method in percentage, profit and loss, time and work, and the other arithmetic chapters that carry the paper.

Buy it if

You need worked examples to understand a method before you can practise it.

Avoid it if

Your weakness is speed rather than concept - a mock series will serve you better.

How to use it

Read a chapter, solve only the exercise questions you got wrong the first time, and revisit them before every mock.

Pros and cons

Pros

  • Theory, solved examples and exercises in every chapter
  • The standard reference most coaching notes assume you own

Cons

  • Long - not a book to start close to an exam
  • Some chapters go past what a constable-level paper asks

Topics covered

  • Percentage
  • Profit and loss
  • Time and work
  • Ratio and proportion
  • Averages
